result.reason: The software conformance warranty reaches the preferred 12-month period and includes repair, replacement, and conditional refund, and the draft adds the required workmanship, legal-compliance, and malicious-code warranties. However, it does not provide the required 90-day services warranty or a remedy for breach of the services warranty; the remedies expressly apply only to clause (b), even though the refund language inconsistently references services. It also leaves language stating that nonconformities may not be corrected, which conflicts with the repair obligation, and retains malformed disclaimer text. The unlimited/undefined services warranty and additions such as conformance to Specifications go beyond the stated position. The changes otherwise remain focused on the warranty allocation and generally preserve unrelated commercial intent.
